normal.name: Marcus Adams
normal.text: Last night I discovered there is a bug in #ElderScrolls 4 Oblivion where after you've been playing for a few hours, the camera moves upward slightly, effectively making your character a little bit taller. This isn't noticeable from a gameplay or viewport perspective, as far as I could tell, but in the Cheydinhal quest to retrieve the ring of burden from the well for the mages' guild, it makes you too tall to fit thru the opening at the bottom of the well unless you reboot the game. #Gaming
